open_gates.detail: Five new Challenge scenarios require six-selector runtime/D-composited/A-V qualification after separate explicit authorization.
Challenge music seeds 840001/840002 and 104 BPM remain proposal-only; E1 tempo_bpm and duration_seconds remain null.

Validate family-specific frame/timebase, codec/profile, pixel format/range, audio stream, loudness/non-silence, samples and A/V drift. Do not impose Challenge yuv420p-TV profile on Loop22 yuvj420p-full-range H.264 stream-copy evidence.
Hydrated/reconciled predecessor references do not alone prove every E6 family-specific technical and operator predicate.
D4.8 R1V V2 remains pinned and BLOCKED for Smoke18/media. Separate governance resolution is mandatory; this ledger cannot override it.
Exact future executable paths, versions, binary hashes, arguments, counts, output roots and stop-on-first-failure rules are not frozen.
CHALLENGE_008/009 remain excluded until the 11-second declaration versus 12-second phase-sum issue has a separate decision.
